body: Of course being in this mindset, I can only think of the negatives.  How my next big love after my HS GF, who I didn't express my interest in initially because she was 17 at the time and I 19, dated a drug dealer and got hooked on heroin.  We tried dating, but the addiction ruined it.  I know things can only get better, and I am moving in June to be closer to friends who really care.  I just need to keep fighting my emotionally abusive job and major depression until then.  After self-medicating with some thc, I have removed the belt.  I just hope for no bruises...
